notes.text: SALARY TABLES: 1.1.2023-31.12.2023 CCNL 2.11.2022 Tabella D (new classification from 1.1.2023; elevata qualificazione art. 100: 35,000 a year with the tredicesima); from 1.1.2024 CCNL 27.10.2025 Tabella 2a. Monthly = annual / 12, the tredicesima paid apart. The old categories of November and December 2022 and the anticipation increments are not modelled. Overtime hourly base: art. 47 c. 7 counts the retribuzione base with the rateo of tredicesima over 156; the run takes the hourly rate the caller states.

Layer 2 implemented. Part-time: engine scales by part_time_pct. Fixed-term: PA is excluded from NASpI addizionale (lavoratori delle pubbliche amministrazioni in statutory exclusion list per INPS guidance); fixed_term_additional_rate=0.000 in tax file. Apprenticeship: no ARAN CCNL defines percentage or under-classification tracks; narrow high-qualification form under D.Lgs. 81/2015 Art. 47 exists for research profiles but is not operationalized in any examined CCNL.
Seniority via DEP (Differenziali Economici di Professionalità) per Art. 60 Fondo incarichi: selective procedure, not automatic — maximum_count=0.

Indennità di specificità infermieristica (Art. 62, Tabella 3) not modelled as fixed_allowance — applies only to specific nursing profiles (infermieri, ostetriche), not universally to all area members.

limitation.remediation: Model l'indennità di specificità infermieristica (Art. 62, Tabella 3) as an allowance gated by a role (infermieri, ostetriche) or record a limitation.

provenance.transformation: 28 days on a five-day week (c. 2); 26 for a worker hired for the first time in a public administration, for the first three years of service (cc. 4-5). The CCNL counts the three years in any public administration ('a qualsiasi titolo prestato' / 'presso una qualsiasi pubblica amministrazione'); the tiers read the seniority with this employer, so a worker with earlier public service gets 26 (30) days when the text gives 28 (32): state the seniority with the earlier public service included.

provenance.note: Job kept 18 months within the three years before the day (the CCNL sums 'le assenze per malattia verificatesi nel triennio precedente' the last episode): 540 days of 30-day months over a window of 3 years; 9 months (270 days) in full, 3 (days 271-360) at 90%, 6 (days 361-540) at 50%. The window ends on the sick day, not on the start of the last episode. The cut of the accessory pay of the first 10 days (D.L. 112/2008 art. 71 c. 1) is not modelled.

provenance.transformation: Bands proposed by a delegated search and checked band by band against the PDF by a separate session. A start day the text does not set is read as the day after the notice; the ratei of the extra months and the TFR treatment are set only where the text states them. The resignation, half of the dismissal terms (Art. 53 c. 2), gives 1 month 15 days in the middle band and is left out.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Salary tables, additional months, hourly and daily divisors, overtime, leave, sickness and seniority, against the CCNL of 2 November 2022 and the definitive CCNL of 27 October 2025.
findings: Salary amounts confirmed (annual table over 12; elevata qualificazione 2023: 35,000 / 13).
The first period started on 2022-11-02, the signing date; the new classification applies from 1 January 2023 (art. 99 c. 3).
Overtime is art. 47 c. 8 of the CCNL 2.11.2022, in force from 2022, not from 2024.
Citations moved from the ipotesi of January 2025 (other article numbers) to the definitive text of 27 October 2025.
Sickness: comporto of 18 months with 9 months at 100%, 3 at 90% and 6 at 50% (art. 40), not 270 days at 100%.
Leave: 26 days for the first three years of a first public employment (art. 35 c. 4).
Signatories: FP CGIL and UIL FPL did not sign; CONFSAL, CGS, CSE and CISL signed.
The 2025-2027 renewal is an ipotesi of 29 July 2026, not in force.

reviews.scope: Periodic review due 2026-12-31: the tabellare of 2024 against Tabella 2a of the CCNL of 27 October 2025, and the status of the 2025-2027 renewal.
findings: Tabella 2a (p. 107): the five annual amounts from 1 January 2024 over 12 give the monthly amounts of the file (21.545,34 / 12 = 1.795,445, 1.795,45 half up). Match.
The 2025-2027 renewal is still the ipotesi of 29 July 2026 on 2026-10-17; renewal_2025_2027_not_modelled stays open with the status recorded. The next review is moved to 2027-01-31.
No independent example (an ARAN worked example or a real payslip of the comparto) was found in this review.
